//: What `hird register copilot-cli` writes. Register hird with the Copilot CLI. Merge this into ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json — `/mcp add` inside a session writes the same file. HIRD_HARNESS is how the board tells this session apart (copilot:1a4f); leave it unset and the agent shows up as `unknown`. `hird` must be on the PATH the CLI inherits — if `task_*` tools do not appear, put the absolute path from `which hird` here.
